summary: Round 2 of PR-A at 8f214e7, reviewed against the r2 delta and the full diff. My earlier major is fixed. OrderStatusHistory.of now cuts the note to 500 UTF-16 units. That is at most 500 Postgres characters, so T3 can no longer fail on the note after the card leg has refunded, and longReason_commitsDone checks this on both the admin and the seller path. The code reviewer's fix also holds. holdsCancelClaim leaves out FAILED claims, so cancelShare.uncovered, the remainder rule, shippingTaken and the legsFor sibling sums no longer count a claim that moved no money. A sibling therefore cannot take the remainder or the shipping while a FAILED shipment can still be shipped. claimCancel calls reclaim on every live shipment first; for a FAILED one this does attempt++ and clears the state, and the shipment is then frozen again against the current state under the order lock. The shares still add up to the paid items plus shipping once, and no frozen amount is counted twice. The next card key is new (-r<n>), so a FAILED key is never replayed. A stale attempt-0 caller can no longer commit or fail the claim (failCancel and commitCancel check the attempt). Concurrent callers on the same attempt send the same key, so payment-service deduplicates them. dropFailedCancel now also does attempt++, so a claim made after a non-dispatch advance cannot reuse a FAILED key (the new IT covers this). The seller id is now resolved once in the controller through sellerId(jwt), so the 403 for an unapproved seller still comes before the ownership 404 in claimCancel. COD plus wallet now adds only the wallet part to refundedAmount; that field is used only for reporting, and this matches the queued ship-cancel-wallet-<sid> credit. creditBack now delegates to enqueue, which runs the same ON CONFLICT (idem_key) DO NOTHING insert, so nothing changes there. The delta adds no new endpoint, no new dependency and no new log data. My round-1 minors are on the backlog and still stand: no settlement watch for a card refund that is PENDING and later FAILED; PR-A must merge together with PR-B (CTO condition 1); and the seller's free-text reason is shown in the customer timeline.
